schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: THE TROUBLE LANE — the terminus of the escalation ladder. A failure that cannot escalate anywhere else RAISES a trouble, and since 2026-09-07 (ticket 9579a6f9cec6) raising is not a door on this device at all: it is one append-only emission from the raiser's own hand, which this device DRAINS and folds. What is a door here is HOLDING — clear and amend, and the fold itself. The FIRST raise writes a ticket and notifies its recipients; every recurrence while that ticket is live increments a count and notifies NOBODY. Only the recipient CLEARS it, and only by naming what changed. A fault that returns after a clear is a NEW ticket at count 1, carrying the fix that did not hold. A false statement in a clear can be corrected by AMEND — the correction stands beside the original (Law 7: the record of truth keeps both), and standing is untouched. The records are git-JSON in CairnCommons/troubles/ — a trouble is shareable provenance, and losing it loses knowledge.
why: Because a system that fails silently cannot tell you how to improve it, and a system that shouts the same failure fifty times cannot either. Akien, 2026-07-25: 'a poke into nothing, a message that can't be delivered, these are bugs. nothing should fail silently. everything that can't escalate somewhere else should fail to trouble tickets until we get no more from the system. it's literally telling you and i how to improve it :)' — and then the damping half: 'a system alarm is raised. it's not raised again and again, it's count can increment... but demanding more attention when there is none to give is not productive.' The trouble stream IS the improvement backlog; the count is what keeps it readable.
sending_is_a_tool_holding_is_owned: THE SPLIT, ratified by Akien 2026-09-07 ('a good choice. i'd forgotten it was it's own device!') and built as ticket 9579a6f9cec6. RAISING is append-only, needs no addressee and no running recipient, so it lives on DiagnosticBase — the mixin every device already composes — as one JSON breadcrumb in the RAISER's own log home, gate 'raise_trouble'. No import, no bus, no lock. HOLDING is a read-modify-write over a shared store, so it stays behind this device's gate (Law 6) and is reached over the bus by the verbs `live` and `clear`. The asymmetry is not an inconsistency, it IS the ownership line. WHY IT HAD TO BE THIS WAY: the fault most worth reporting is the one raised by a process that can reach nobody — a bare `python3 -m` inspector run, a boot that failed before the bus. A raise that required a live lane would go silent exactly there, which is the failure this whole component exists to end (Law 7). There is deliberately NO `raise` verb on the bus: a second path to the same act is a path that fails when the first one would have worked.
the_damping_insight: THE TROUBLE TICKET IS THE DAMPER, and this is the reason the component exists in this shape. The open question it closed was chatter: a predicate flapping across its line raises the same fault fifty times. The reflex answer was hysteresis — pick a width, suppress inside it — which needs a NUMBER nobody has measured, and a width set too wide silently eats real faults. Identity-plus-count dissolves the question rather than tuning it: the scarce thing is ATTENTION, not occurrence, and attention is spent in full the moment the first ticket lands. Fifty flaps become one ticket that says 50, with no width to guess and nothing silently eaten. (Law 1, one level up — the answered question became structure instead of a knob.)
how_it_learns: It does not learn on its own, and that is deliberate — the LANE is dumb so the stream can be read. What learns is the pair of humans (for now, one human and CC) reading it: the trouble stream is the standing evidence of where the system is weak, and its horizon is its own emptiness. The count is the learning signal that matters — a ticket at count 1 is an incident, a ticket at count 400 is a design defect, and the same file says which without anyone re-deriving it. `prior_attempts` and `recurred_after_clear` are the second signal: a fault that keeps coming back after fixes names each fix that did not hold. If a learning loop is ever wanted here, that is the data it would run on; nothing is built ahead of that need.

laws.law_6: ONE DOOR, AND THE DOOR IS THE FOLD. TroubleDevice is still the only writer of a trouble file — incrementing, clearing and amending all go through it, because the lane's whole value is that a count is trustworthy, and a count is only trustworthy if there is one way to increment it. What changed in 2026-09-07 is where the raiser stands relative to that door: it no longer holds this device to knock, it drops a breadcrumb in its own log home and the shim's drain carries it through. That STRENGTHENS the one-writer property rather than weakening it — before, every raiser constructed its own TroubleDevice and two raisers of one fault could race the JSON; now the fold happens in the one process that owns the store.
laws.law_7: BOTH HALVES, SPLIT DELIBERATELY. The RECORD is never damped — the count is exact, the timestamps move, a bounded tail keeps the shape of the recurrence. What is damped is the NOTIFICATION. A record of truth never collapses; a demand for attention always may.
laws.law_3: The normal operating state — live() empty — is a MEASURED claim about the system, readable at any moment, not an aspiration in prose.
laws.law_8: The lane must not go dark on its own fault: a malformed trouble file surfaces AS a live trouble, and any standing that is not an explicit CLEARED counts as live. Silence in the component built to end silence would be the hollow build.

the_normal_operating_state: live() is EMPTY. Akien: 'the intention for the normal-operating-state is there won't be any active trouble tickets. and it'll be a rarity when there is one. but we're a long way from there.' The distance from zero is the honest measure of how far the system has to go, which is why the count is on the device's own state() rather than somewhere it has to be gone looking for.
who_is_told: For now, CC gets them all (DEFAULT_RECIPIENTS). This is a stopgap and is written down as one. Akien: 'for now, you get them all. so when they show up, you can fix. but eventually you'll have help that'll do that for you.' The notified and cleared sets are already PER-RECIPIENT — because the clear is per-recipient — so that help arrives as an entry in a list, not a redesign.

filed_edges.edge: DELIVERY TO A HUMAN. The raise now pokes the LANE the moment it lands (an injected notifier, ticket 9579a6f9cec6) so the panel does not wait for a beat; with no notifier wired, the drain folds it on the beat and the record was never at risk. What is still unbuilt is the hop beyond the lane — telling Akien somewhere he is actually looking.
filed_edges.why_it_waits: `notified` names the recipient and `cleared_by` gates on them, so the list is already the right shape; what is missing is a carrier. Faking one here would be the hollow build — the ticket is written either way, so nothing is lost, and the honest gap is visible in the return value.

filed_edges.edge: AUTOMATIC RAISING from the failure sites — an undeliverable poke, a carrier that raised, a held diagnostic with no receiver.
filed_edges.why_it_waits: The DOOR is no longer the obstacle — every device composes DiagnosticBase and can raise without importing anything. What still has to be argued per site is the IDENTITY: it is what makes two occurrences the same trouble, and a bad one either splits one defect into hundreds of tickets or merges hundreds into one. Wiring them one at a time, with the identity argued each time, still beats a blanket hook.

filed_edges.edge: HYSTERESIS / chatter damping at the probe, filed on bus-completion.
filed_edges.why_it_may_never_be_built: Likely DISSOLVED by this component rather than deferred: if the flood only matters because it demands attention, identity-plus-count already cures it with no width to guess. Held as a hypothesis, not a conclusion (Law 3) — re-check when a real flapping predicate lands and it is measured whether anything still hurts.

provenance.born_from: The first trouble was hand-written before this device existed (CairnCommons/troubles/append-door-has-no-schema-gate.json) because the append door failed silently and the lane it should have escalated to had no address. The directory was named in CLAUDE.md's roots table and did not exist on disk.
provenance.found_on_first_contact: The device's live() filter tested equality against 'OPEN' and read the hand-written standing 'OPEN — reported complete, awaiting Akien's ratify' as NOT live — reporting zero troubles with an open one on disk. Fixed structurally: only an explicit CLEARED is quiet. The component's first act was to catch itself doing the thing it exists to prevent.

learns: It does not; it is the trouble panel — it surfaces and tracks troubles without learning from them.
